title: Here's my power rankings for the big 4 hyperscalers after this earnings season
summary: In his latest column, Jim Cramer ranks the four major hyperscalers following the recent earnings season. He highlights Amazon as his top choice based on its performance in the second quarter. This evaluation reflects the competitive landscape among these tech giants and their financial results. Cramer's insights provide a clear perspective on the strengths of each company during this earnings period.
